info.title: Cloud Document Ingestion Pipeline
info.summary: Control-plane API for document ingestion; binary objects go to S3 via presign.
info.description:
## Control vs data plane

This API manages metadata, jobs, and audit. **Files never stream through the API.** Clients obtain a **presigned PUT** URL and upload directly to S3.

## Auth and headers

- **JWT** Bearer (RS256) identifies the tenant and role.
- **Idempotency-Key** on `POST /v1/documents`.
- **X-Correlation-ID** must be a UUIDv7 when supplied; the server generates one if missing.
- Errors use **RFC 7807** Problem Details (`application/problem+json`).
- Cross-tenant IDs return **404**, not 403.

## Outbound webhooks

Clients may receive signed outbound webhooks (`document.processed` / `document.failed`) with header `X-Webhook-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256).

expires_at.description: UTC expiry of the presigned URL.

required_headers.title: Required Headers
required_headers.description: Headers the client must include on PUT: Content-Type, checksum, SSE-KMS keys.
